pages.text: A knot remains still on the bench, yet the resonator draws something from it. The needle settles only while the surrounding field is quiet. Resonance is the workshop name for that difference.
pages.title: A useful residue
A held movement
pages.text: A Stillness Resonator supplies 20 Resonance per tick on sheltered or liberated ground. Nearby instruments share the same field; leave seven blocks between their centres for separate output.

pages.title: The condenser
pages.text: Place a flake in the left slot and supply power. The right slot receives the refined essence. One flake needs 4000 Resonance and ten seconds of powered work.

pages.title: The condenser
pages.text: The resonator does not burn its knot. Hoppers can feed the condenser and collect its result. Compatible FE equipment can supply power through the same connection. A redstone signal pauses a generator.

pages.title: Keep a sample
pages.text: The refined material holds together better than the scrap it came from. Copper, glass and a little essence are enough for the next instruments.

pages.title: Keep a sample
pages.text: The crafting pages record the preparations currently understood. Save a few samples before committing the whole stock to one project.
